# A third invoice, for the same customer as the first, naming the deposit whose
# portions have both already settled documents — and naming only the
# transaction, so nothing says which split it means.
#
# There is no split left for it to move: each is in a lot holding a document
# that reads as paid. Taking one anyway would settle this invoice and leave
# that document silently unpaid, with every figure in the book still balancing.
invoice "INV-TWO-A-SECOND"
	customer_id: "C-TWO-A"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-06-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-06-01
		description: "Service A again"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-06-02
		due: 2026-07-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-TWO-A-SECOND"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-05-15
		amount: 100
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		memo: "Portion for Alpha"
